entries.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit target Image 1 is an EXISTING FULL-BODY GAME CHARACTER in tan hooded camouflage light armor, bare face, brown short hair and beard, dark knee pads, black lace-up boots, brown belt and backpack straps. Preserve EXACT armor identity and full-body stance, legs and boots. Supporting insert Image 2 is the exact equipped weapon: SVD rifle with long thin barrel, wooden ventilated fore-end, wooden skeleton thumbhole buttstock, black cheek pad, small black magazine and attached black telescopic scope. Put that exact SVD naturally into the existing character's raised hands, aiming horizontally RIGHT, stock firmly seated in the right shoulder, right hand around the SVD's wooden thumbhole grip with index finger at trigger, left hand supporting under the WOODEN FORE-END well forward of the magazine. Both arms must stay anatomically connected and naturally posed as a single complete illustration; small necessary repositioning of hands and elbows is allowed. Face must aim along scope with eye clearly BEHIND eyepiece and visible eye-relief space, never scope passing through face. Entire character, both boots and full rifle muzzle must fit comfortably inside a PORTRAIT 1024x1536 image; shrink whole figure uniformly for room if needed, never shorten rifle. Preserve original realistic illustrated game style and original costume. Background genuinely transparent alpha, no floor, no shadow, no brown glow, no text, no frame. One complete finished character with weapon, never detached parts.
entries.correctionPrompt: Precise correction of this complete transparent game sprite. Everything is already correct EXCEPT the scope touches the brow: create a VISIBLE GAP of about 25 pixels between the man's brow/nose and the scope's rubber eyepiece by drawing his WHOLE HEAD 30 pixels farther BACK (to LEFT), connected naturally to same neck/hood, still looking RIGHT and aligned with scope. Preserve exact man identity, tan camouflage suit, all armor, boots, rifle design/position/size, entire existing natural hands and arms with grip and support, body posture, whole canvas and full-body composition. Do NOT move scope/rifle toward character. The head is behind the scope with visible open air in between. Keep fully transparent background (real alpha), remove any background brown glow, floor/shadow. Exactly the same complete 1024x1536 portrait sprite with only head position corrected.

notes: Existing whole-character aiming pose used as edit target; small natural whole-arm adjustments fit the SVD.
Initial generation placed eyepiece against brow/visor; corrected complete head placement and rechecked visible gap.
Costume and SVD identities are visually preserved; generated illustration is not pixel-identical to source weapon.
Original generated alpha retained. SVD approximate lengths 766 px and approximately 750 px differ by about 2% after final heavy-suit correction across the two armor sprites.
Two isolated one-pixel antialias edge speckles remain, with alpha at most 17/255; no visible opaque background.
